total-fertility-rate-trends.alt: Line graph of total fertility rate from 1960 to 2020 for two invented countries, with a dashed line at replacement level, about 2.1. Country A falls from 6.8 in 1960 to 2.8 in 2020, still above replacement. Country B falls from 3.6 in 1960 to 2.2 in 1980 and to 1.5 in 2020, below replacement since about 1985.
